requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver is to start the watchdog, the IWDG LL driver shall write the value 0xCCCC to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: The test passes when the IWDG_KR.KEY field in the ll_iwdg_regs array is set to 0xCCCC after calling the start function.

requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver is to refresh the watchdog counter, the IWDG LL driver shall write the value 0xAAAA to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: The test passes when the IWDG_KR.KEY field in the ll_iwdg_regs array is set to 0xAAAA after calling the refresh function.

requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver is to enable write access to IWDG_PR and IWDG_RLR, the IWDG LL driver shall write the value 0x5555 to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: The test passes when the IWDG_KR.KEY field in the ll_iwdg_regs array is set to 0x5555 after calling the enable write access function.

requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver is to disable write access to IWDG_PR and IWDG_RLR, the IWDG LL driver shall write any value other than 0x5555 to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: The test passes when the IWDG_KR.KEY field in the ll_iwdg_regs array is set to a value other than 0x5555 after calling the disable write access function.
